notes.title: Nocturnal Survivors v0.6 Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello survivors,[/p][p][/p][p]Nocturnal Survivors v0.6 update will be released on Sep 12. It includes new content as follows.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622165/cc2edce07956644308298c668ba3163d45c68600.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Gameplay feature[/h2][list][*][p]6 new combo weapons. All of them are epic![/p][/*][*][p]7 new artifacts including 3 superior, 2 rare and 2 epic.[/p][/*][*][p]Add 33 Steam achievements.[/p][/*][*][p]Add mutation mechanism to allow player improve base attributes by spending collected genes.[/p][/*][*][p]Add new monster variant: Gene carrier, who drops genes instead of usual pickables when killed.[/p][/*][*][p]Add new interactable object: Force generator. Once activated, it severely reduces monster's speed in the range for 30 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]New wizard screen to start a new mission.[/p][/*][*][p]New Biomes are locked until player survives for 10 days in previous biome.[/p][/*][*][p]To-be-locked weapons and artifacts are marked when they appear in upgrade screen.[/p][/*][*][p]In Unlocks screen, display combo even when weapon is locked to give player a hint how to unlock it.[/p][/*][*][p]Various minor UI changes.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugfix[/h2][list][*][p]Fix an issue that Upgrade: recycle weapon cannot be picked.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What's Next[/h2][p]Next update will be 1.0 which is the full release on Sep 30. Yes, we're leaving EA! Here're some news I'd like to share:[/p][list][*][p]Legendary weapons. These super-powerful weapons require more combo to make but extremely powerful to allow player comfortably break through day 10.[/p][/*][*][p]New characters. Unlock new character on each biome. These characters have special perk to give you more fun in fighting against hordes of monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]One more new map: Huanted Park.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Yes! You can play Nocturnal Survivors on Steam Deck!
notes.notes: [p]Hi Survivors,[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to Proton tech, you can play Nocturnal Survivors on Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][p]There is one known issue that some UI are not responsive to the Steam Deck controls. You can click them on the touch screen as workaround. We are still investigating how to fix this issue.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for the support![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622165/a1f11a779ec2b29ab25196d01f303afe57e20aef.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Nocturnal Survivors v0.5 Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello survivors,[/p][p][/p][p]Nocturnal Survivors v0.5 update will be released on Aug 1. It includes new content as follows.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622165/864f93839e03d4b70206972d00523be308340635.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Gameplay feature[/h2][list][*][p]New map: Alien relics.[/p][/*][*][p]5 new monsters in the new map.[/p][/*][*][p]New basic weapon: Iron fist. Launch an iron fist to nearby enemies. Hit enemies will be knocked back.[/p][/*][*][p]7 new combo weapons including 5 rare and 2 epic.[/p][/*][*][p]3 new artifacts including 1 rare, 1 epic and 1 legendary.[/p][/*][*][p]New weapon will not appear when level-up until all existing weapons have level maximized. Besides, total number of equipped weapons does not depend on player level anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum level of most weapons are reduced:[/p][list][*][p]Superior weapon: 8 -> 7[/p][/*][*][p]Rare weapon: 10 -> 8[/p][/*][*][p]Epic weapon: 12 -> 10[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The two changes above make combo weapon much more easier to get. This matches the design purpose on how the game is played.[/p][/*][*][p]Plasma ray emitted from plasma raygun is anchored on position instead of enemy. Range of ray is calculated correctly by upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Change key bindings on gamepad:[/p][list][*][p]\[A] Interact[/p][/*][*][p]\[B] Back[/p][/*][*][p]\[X] Dash[/p][/*][*][p]\[Y] Reroll[/p][/*][*][p]\[LB] Mission info[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What's Next[/h2][p]Next update (v0.6) will be on Sep 12. To be honest, I haven't made final decision on what 0.6 will be. But I will stop making new map/monster for now.[/p][p][/p][p]I may put more focus on UI and progression as we already have 4 maps, 20 monsters, 40+ weapons in EA, the priority should be shifted to how these stuff could be orchestrated to make meaningful progression for players.[/p][p][/p][p]But as always, a few more weapons and artifacts can be expected. :D[/p]

notes.title: Nocturnal Survivors v0.4 Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello survivors,[/p][p][/p][p]Nocturnal Survivors v0.4 update will be released on Aug 1. It includes new content as follows.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622165/e2c98582f224f81b6ed1646f5e6b6d208df1aee8.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Gameplay feature[/h2][list][*][p]New map: Rust moorland.[/p][/*][*][p]5 new monsters in the new map.[/p][/*][*][p]5 new combo weapons including 4 rare and 1 epic.[/p][/*][*][p]5 new artifacts including 1 superior, 2 rare, 1 epic and 1 legendary.[/p][/*][*][p]New elite variant for monsters: spacetime traveler. Monsters in other biomes can be warpped into current biome. They are stronger than usual monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]New event: Dimensional matrix appears randomly at night. It lasts for 30 seconds. It will include:[/p][list][*][p]New map and monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]More elite variants for monsters and random events.[/p][/*][*][p]More combo weapons and artifacts.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon balance refactor. (TBD)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Nocturnal Survivors v0.3 Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello survivors,[/p][p][/p][p]Nocturnal Survivors v0.3 update will be released on Jul 9. Two days earlier than planned as I will have a holiday with family this weekend. This is the biggest update since the early release I hope everyone enjoys![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622165/0f9025d481b126e303a2928aaa58b3d12b64e140.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Gameplay feature[/h2][list][*][p]New map: Fungi valley.[/p][/*][*][p]5 new monsters in the new map.[/p][/*][*][p]More elite variants for monsters. Monsters now have chance to be granted high resistance to certain damage type.[/p][/*][*][p]New basic weapon: Crossbow. Fires piercing bolt to nearby enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]6 new combo weapons including 5 rare and 1 epic.[/p][/*][*][p]7 new artifact including 1 superior, 3 rare, 2 epic and 1 legendary.[/p][/*][*][p]New interactable object: Vending machine. A rocket-driven vending machine lands nearby on every sunrise. Player can buy upgrades, artifacts and suppliers with tokens which are dropped from killed monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]New interactable object: Nuke. Player can detonate nuke to inflict huge damage to both ememies and player.[/p][/*][*][p]New interactable object: Vault hunter. Vault hunter is a monster which does not attack player but instead keeps runing away from player. Kill it to have a vault dropped down.[/p][/*][*][p]More information in best records. Previous records have no kill and weapon information. Player can clear best records as well.[/p][/*][*][p]Walk speeds of all monsters decresed in various degrees.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade: increase pickup area works for all pickable items. Previously it only works for experience items.[/p][/*][*][p]Pickup area radius increased from 2 to 2.5.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor balance change on various weapons.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bugfix[/h2][list][*][p]Player will not continuously push colliding monsters when dashing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix piercing spark visual effect position issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix monster elite icon shading issue when icon is displayed on half-bottom of the screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Technical enhancement[/h2][list][*][p]Switch physics engine to Jolt.[/p][/*][*][p]Greatly improve performance on generating terrain bumping.[/p][/*][*][p]Support following languages: French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese. Please note all translations are done by LLM, except English and Chinese so quality may vary. That said, the game titles in different languages may not reflect the game itself well, if you have a better translation feel free to contact me![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What's Next?[/h2][p]Next update (v0.4) will be on Aug 1. It will include:[/p][list][*][p]New map and monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]More elite variants for monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]More combo weapons and artifacts.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon balance refactor. (TBD)[/p][/*][*][p]More interactable objects. (TBD)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Nocturnal Survivors v0.2 Update
notes.notes: [p]Nocturnal Survivors v0.2 Update will be released on Jun 20, 2025. Here's update details:[/p][h2]Gameplay Feature[/h2][list][*][p]New basic weapon: Acid bomb. An acid bomb is thrown to nearby enemies and splash a corrosive area when hit ground.[/p][/*][*][p]New basic weapon: LN2 blaster. A firarm shoots bullets fused with liquid nitrogen which cause a small blast damages and slows enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]5 new combo weapons including 4 rare and 1 epic.[/p][/*][*][p]8 new artifacts including 2 superior, 2 rare and 4 epic.[/p][/*][*][p]New monster: Harpooneer. A ranged-attack zombie called Harpooneer spawned from Day 9.[/p][/*][*][p]Melee monsters have attack animation and pre/post attack delay updated to accommodate the animation.[/p][/*][*][p]When level up, at least one combo weapon is always in upgrade list whenever available.[/p][/*][*][p]When level up and only one last weapon remains to pick, the weapon in upgrade list is always upgradable to a combo weapon with existing weapons whenever available.[/p][/*][*][p]When level up, player no longer heals in default. This effect is moved to a new-added artifact.[/p][/*][*][p]Player dash distance reduced from 7 to 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Reroll cost is increased by one after each reroll. It will reset to one after you take an upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Vaults are spawned much closer to the camp.[/p][/*][*][p]Add tags for weapon to highlight key specifications. In future, these tags could be used for more combinations and play styles.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Visual Effect[/h2][list][*][p]Enemy has white visual effect when hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Improve explosion visual effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Environment object becomes transparent when it blocks player from camera view.[/p][/*][*][p]Some UI improvements in Unlock screen.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Technical Enhancement[/h2][list][*][p]Support gamepad.[/p][/*][*][p]Integrate with Steam API.[/p][/*][*][p]Add option to enable antialiasing in Settings. Enabled by default.[/p][/*][*][p]Monster attack range check depends on physics engine.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622165/0896616b8a7dc8a2536e66dbb32bd51b6cd39212.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622165/7c741d69ad4c5025446f10da14ee979b0dc1f133.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What's next?[/h2][p]Update v0.3 is scheduled to be released on Jul 11. Current plan includes following updates:[/p][list][*][p]1 new map.[/p][/*][*][p]5 new monsters in the new map.[/p][/*][*][p]More elite variants for monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]1 basic weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]More combo weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade game engine. Adopt to Jolt physics engine.[/p][/*][*][p]Support more languages. (Machine translation)[/p][/*][/list]
